scopeRestriction.rationale: Retain only simple rational-power/sine or polynomial/e combinations with one parameter. The compulsory right-column family restriction applies to inner- and outer-mathematical problems and is explicitly inherited by reconstruction on p.20. K3 supports model construction and contextual reading.
scopeRestriction.openDissent: Partial combined inference; the parameter example alone does not establish context interpretation. Regression and Ortskurven follow the LK-only heading on p.20, despite misleading GK_LK extraction tags; neither is used as GK evidence. General logarithmic functions and multi-parameter families are excluded.
